Jobs.description: Configures how the runs of jobs execute, used by the 'OrchardCore.Jobs' feature. Can be set for all tenants or per tenant. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Jobs/.

MaxConcurrentRuns.description: The number of runs of a tenant a server executes at the same time. The other runs wait, queued, for one to end, or for another server.

MaxConcurrentRunsPerServer.description: The number of runs a server executes at the same time for all its tenants. 0 doesn't limit them. Set it in the application configuration, as the value of the first tenant that executes a run applies.

HeartbeatSeconds.description: How often, in seconds, a server reports that a run is still executing, and saves its progress and its log. A cancellation requested from another server is seen at that time.

AbandonedAfterMinutes.description: The number of minutes after which a running run that stopped reporting is considered abandoned by its server. It is queued again when it has attempts left, and fails otherwise.

RunRetentionDays.description: The number of days the runs that ended are kept; older runs are deleted. 0 keeps them.
